A '''diminutive species''' of pale [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. A distinctive feature of the species was the presence of three fingers on each of their four [[Limb/Legends|hands]] and round white [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] without pupils.<ref name="SW40" />

During the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], many members of this species worked at the [[Golden Nyss Shipyards]], including [[Gzin]], who received incoming cargo. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the reptilian [[Yinchorri/Legends|Yinchorri]] warriors [[Raid on the Golden Nyss Shipyards|infiltrated]] the station and carried out a massacre. The Yinchorri seized all the docked ships and then destroyed the shipyards.<ref name="SW40" />
